subject: general
question: Which emperor shifted his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Bin Tughlaq.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Muhammad Bin Tughlaq**

__
 
• **He was the eighteenth sultan **of the** Delhi Sultanate.**
 
• Founder of the **Tughlaq dynasty.**
 
• He** **imposed heavy tax in the land between the** Ganga and the Yamuna rivers** in his reign.
 
• In 1327, he ordered to move his capital from **Delhi to Daulatabad **(**Devagiri in Maharashtra) **in the** Deccan region of India.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Firoz Shah Tughlaq

 
• Ruler from the **Tughlaq dynasty, reigned over the Sultanate of Delhi from 1351 to 1388.**
 
• He repaired the **Qutub Minar which had been damaged by an earthquake.**
 
• He had around **180,000 slaves** to get support in** ruling over Delhi.**

**Muhammad Ghouri**

 
• **Sultan of the Ghurid Empire from 1173 to 1206**.
 
• He is credited with** laying the foundation of Muslim rule in the Indian subcontinent.**

**Allauddin Khalji**

 
• Emperor of the** Khalji dynasty that ruled the Delhi Sultanate in the Indian subcontinent.**
 
• He fended off several **Mongol invasions of India.**
